rationale: The structure family uses the supplied original bound ligand and receptor, matching the supported restrained pose-anchor hypothesis. The supplied anisotropic ligand geometry makes that restraint plausible; comparing anchor weight 2 and native_rms_ratio 0.2 is an explicitly allowed parameter hypothesis, not a causal conclusion from endpoint associations. No time ramp is proposed because this condition removes temporal instructions and supplies no robust temporal evidence.
failure_modes: Endpoint coordinate associations are observational and do not establish that these parameter changes improve predicted pIC50.
The structure has no affinity labels, so the anchor is a geometric restraint rather than an affinity reward.
A stronger anchor or tighter native RMS restraint may preserve the starting pose at the cost of useful conformational changes.
Evaluation must include predicted pIC50, strain, and pose deviation; the supplied evidence does not validate these outcomes.
